stories.title: Uber Confirms Data Breach – Hackers Stole Users’ Personal Information
stories.description: Uber has confirmed a data breach involving the personal information of thousands of U.S. drivers after hackers accessed records held by Fireworks AI, a third-party technology provider.

stories.title: FAA Ground Stop Issued Due to ‘Extraordinary Circumstances’
stories.description: Federal officials have yet to say what caused the communications disruption or whether they are investigating a possible cyberattack.

stories.title: PostgreSQL Patches 52 Flaws, Including 22-Year-Old Bug Enabling Authenticated RCE
stories.description: PostgreSQL fixes 52 security flaws, including CVE-2026-6460, which allows users with object creation privileges to execute server code.

stories.title: New Mior and Skyfall Attacks Let Rogue Cloud Hosts Steal Secrets From AMD SEV-SNP VMs
stories.description: Mior and Skyfall attacks expose data in AMD SEV-SNP confidential VMs, with Mior also enabling memory changes and forged attestation reports.

stories.title: New TypoPrompting Attacks Turn Mistyped AI Website Addresses Into Malware Installation Traps
stories.description: TypoPrompting exploits mistyped AI website addresses to redirect users to fake pages that deliver malware and browser hijackers.

stories.title: In Other News: New CISA Director Nominee, Connected Car Hacking, Baker Tilly Data Breach
stories.description: Noteworthy stories that might have slipped under the radar: Siemens details security advisory policy, OpenAI Codex backdoor risk, Microsoft warns of model weight backdoors.

stories.title: Hackers Use SANSAR Linux Malware to Hide Crypto Mining by Faking 0% GPU Usage
stories.description: Hackers hide Linux cryptocurrency mining by spoofing GPU usage readings, making active mining appear as 0% utilization.

stories.title: Hackers Use 2,700 Passwords to Break Into Microsoft SQL Servers and Deploy Remote Access Malware
stories.description: Hackers brute-force exposed Microsoft SQL servers using 2,700 passwords to deploy cryptocurrency miners and remote access trojans.

stories.title: FBI Says North Korean Hackers Stole Over $400 Million in Crypto Using Deepfake Video Calls
stories.description: FBI says North Korea-linked FaceStealer stole over $400 million in crypto using fake video calls; U.S. authorities seized its infrastructure.

stories.title: Trezor Confirms Hidden Implants in CryptoBilis-Sold Wallets That Can Steal Recovery Phrases
stories.description: Trezor confirms recovery phrase-stealing implants in three CryptoBilis-sold Safe 5 wallets and says firmware 2.13.1 blocks known implants.

stories.title: Microsoft Struggles to Restore Email and Other Services in a Global Outage
stories.description: Microsoft is trying different ways to identify the cause of the problem and get its servers back online, using “a measured approach to identify and repair affected infrastructure.”

stories.title: Apify Confirms Customer Data Accessed in Cyberattack
stories.description: The web scraping company says an intruder accessed customer accounts and obtained personal information or stored data.
